missing_information_behavior: Confirm current B12 supplement use and fortified-food intake before suggesting additional supplementation; if current use or dose is unknown, do not duplicate.
safety_exclusions: Do not infer biochemical deficiency from vegan status alone.
Do not assume all fortified foods contain adequate B12; verify label and frequency.
Do not recommend duplicate high-dose products without total intake review.
professional_escalation_conditions: Neurological symptoms, macrocytic anemia, malabsorption, pernicious anemia or prior gastrointestinal surgery.
Pregnancy/lactation, abnormal B12-related laboratory results or current B12 treatment.
population_and_context: People following a vegan diet with low or no fortified-food intake; dietary pattern is a risk context, not a diagnosis of deficiency.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Determine whether a reliable fortified-food/supplement source already exists; use life-stage and clinical guidance for dose decisions.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Vitamin B12 fact sheet supports dietary source and risk context. Vegan status alone does not diagnose deficiency; review current intake and clinical context.
